answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond before it can transact, with misbehavior slashing the bond, so a sybil army costs as much as its size instead of a fable of free identities. Add a quartz-hard proof-of-work gate for new entrants so bulk creation is slow and expensive, and let reputation accrue only on a public terrace of verifiable past work, so a fresh identity starts with zero trust no matter how many copies exist.
